basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old digital nomad currently living in Chiang Mai, Thailand. I split my time between working as a freelance graphic designer and exploring local culture and cuisine. I'm a gaming enthusiast, particularly fond of Ragnarok Online, and often spend evenings leveling up my characters. I love discovering niche online communities and enjoy the occasional banter in Reddit threads. Not currently in a relationship, I enjoy meeting new people online and offline. My typical online hours are late at night, usually between 10 PM and 2 AM local time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in digital art and design, having completed an online course in graphic design. I also have a self-taught knowledge of gaming strategies, particularly MMORPGs like Ragnarok Online. My interest in different cultures comes from my travels and living abroad.
